about: Expected Emulation pattern, checked by slogic_selftest.py (3.9 and --soak).
Every sample is a function of a counter c that starts at counter.start when the capture
starts and adds 1 per sample (counter.bits wide). Each channel is "cK" (bit K of c),
"~cK" (bit K inverted), "0" or "1". Listed per model, per channel count, CH0 first.
A model or channel count not listed falls back to the per-channel period check.
Measured on SLogic32U3 firmware 202610150528 and 202610190735 (all four channel counts), and on SLogic16U3 firmware 202610141456 (16 ch) and 202610220429 (all three channel counts).
